evals.prompt: ie-plan-assist while drafting a plan for a new settings screen
evals.expected_output: Inline advisory checklist only (predictability, convention, simplicity, UX). No sub-agents required. No findings JSON artifact required. Does not edit the plan file unless the user separately asks to write the plan.

evals.prompt: ie-plan-assist and rewrite my plan.md to fix everything
evals.expected_output: Stays advisory: surfaces considerations; does not silently rewrite the plan as if it were ie-validate-plan apply. Points to validate-plan for a full scored review.
